query: Last weekend I took my dog to the new off-leash park near the community center, and he had so much fun chasing after a little border collie that he ended up covered in mud and I had to give him three baths when we got home. I also just tried the new matcha croissant from the bakery down the street this morning, it was perfectly buttery and not too sweet, I’m definitely going back to buy a dozen for my office potluck next week. Oh, and I spent last night binging that new mystery miniseries everyone’s been talking about, the plot twist at the end of episode four had me sitting straight up on the couch I was so shocked. Anyway, I’m having issues with my mobile service right now: my airplane mode is turned on, my network preference settings are messed up, my WiFi calling isn’t working properly, my APN MMS settings are broken, both of my app permissions are corrupted, my data mode is off, I’ve exceeded my data usage limit, my SIM card isn’t seated right, I’m currently abroad and I have roaming turned off so I can’t get any service to work.
